headline: A new version of Wyrm
author: OM Rajput
releaseNotes: 22 languages: Wyrm uses your phone's language, change it in Settings > Language.
Global chat and DMs reworked: replies, edits, search, @mentions and who's typing.
Reactions, GIFs and stickers in chat, and Seen in DMs.
Battledome events in the app: schedules, live events and who is playing.
Arena picker with live minimaps and the top 10 for each arena.
New food textures, skin textures, bead styles and a new Skin page.
Arrow mode like the original game: second finger or double tap to boost.
All tags supported, private tags too (Skin > Tags).
Smoother play with many snakes, plus many fixes.
